1: # 实施公共规则
2: 
3: 用户已授权：A 先交付基础，随后 B/C/D 并行，E 全程跟进；具体编码由本机 OpenCode 的 orchestrator 完成。Codex 任务负责监督、必要审批、验证和结构化汇报。
4: 
5: ## Token 与沟通
6: 
7: - 一次下发任务书，之后不要进行 Codex 与 Orchestrator 的开放式反复对话。
8: - 正常运行只读服务状态、权限/问题事件、Git 摘要和测试退出码，不把思考过程、工具全文或完整会话导出送入第二个模型。
9: - 故障时先读最后一个错误的最小片段（建议最多 2000 字符），再决定是否需要修复指令。任务确有缺口时允许一次具体纠偏，不机械重复提示继续。
10: - 完成报告不超过 500 字，必须包含 commit、测试命令/结果、剩余阻塞。伪造通过或只靠 mock 宣称真实服务已接入不可接受。
11: 
12: ## 分支和文件归属
13: 
14: - master 为稳定基线，dev 为集成分支；各工作包 feature/mvp-* 独立 worktree。仅总协调任务集成 dev，未经请求不发布 master、不推送远端。
15: - 所有工作树位于本项目 .worktrees/，不访问旧 openvela 文档或其他业务仓库。只在分配的工作树写代码。
16: - A 独占公共构建、数据库迁移、契约 Schema、认证/幂等/OSS 基础适配、Python 队列运行时；后续共享变更提交请求，由总协调安排唯一负责人。
17: - B 独占 identity/devices/notifications 业务及 notifications Python handler；C 独占 care Java 业务；D 独占 assessments Java 业务及 assessment/identity-enroll/plan Python handler；E 独占 backend/acceptance 的黑盒测试及验收资料。
18: - 不修改 backend/doc/site 或 web；不在各包重写主设计。契约缺口记录到本包交付说明，协调后统一更新。
19: - 不删除/修改用户 logs，不触碰其他工作树。总协调可读取项目 .coordination 下各包的结构化状态用于调度；其他包不能以此获得修改别组代码的权限。
20: 
21: ## 权限和运行隔离
22: 
23: - 当前 worktree 内普通读写、构建、测试可批准；只读编译器/SDK/依赖缓存目录可按实际需要批准。具体工具的自动安全审查仍必须遵守。
24: - 不使用 opencode --auto，不改变全局权限为 allow-all，不无条件批准 external_directory 通配访问。
25: - 项目外业务源码、私人文件、真实密钥、真实人脸上传、付费开通、生产修改、远端推送/发布、破坏性清理不在本轮一般实施授权内；权限事件逐项核实，不能当确认按钮全点。
26: - 测试数据库/容器/端口按 worktree 隔离，不能以共享同一个数据库来并行跑会清理数据的测试。
27: - 使用用户已配置的 OpenCode orchestrator 和默认模型；不擅自切换模型、提供方或 omo 配置。
28: 
29: ## 监督和状态
30: 
31: - 在本项目 .coordination/<包名>/ 保存精简状态：worktree、branch、opencode session/server（不含密码）、phase、last_progress_at、commit、tests、blocker、next_action。
32: - OpenCode 凭据只保存在权限受限的运行时位置/环境，不进入状态、Git、日志或回复。
33: - 权限/问题/执行结束事件及时处理；30 分钟巡检作兜底，正常进行不重复发消息。先使用确定性工具过滤事件，只有需判断时才唤起模型。
34: - 服务/机器休眠会影响巡检，不声称无人值守监控永远在线。
35: - 成功先本包提交，汇报总协调并等待集成；不自行合并其他包、不反复新建 OpenCode 会话。
36: 
37: ## 面板维护
38: 
39: 各包监督任务维护自己的精简 status.json，可增加 completedItems（已验证完成项），测试和下一步应及时更新。总协调统一生成 backend/doc/tasks/panels/ 下总览与 A—E 面板；各 feature 不直接修改其他包或主工作树面板。半小时巡检和里程碑时刷新，只有证据支持才标记完成。

41: ## Oracle 审查门禁（用户新增要求）
42: 
43: 每个业务模块完成后，必须由 OpenCode 的 Oracle 审查。A 公共基础、E 验收框架也遵循此门禁。B 按 M1/M2/M5 分别给结论；C 对 M4 执行与记账给结论；D 对 M3 和 M4 方案生成 Worker 给结论，最终由 E 验证 M4 跨包链路。

45: 流程：实施与自测 → 提交候选代码 → Orchestrator 实际调用已安装 Oracle → 修复阻塞 → Oracle 复审最终代码 → E 独立验收 → 总协调确认集成。为让 E 执行测试，可以集成候选到隔离 dev；在 Oracle 与 E 均通过前，不开放下一阶段、不声称已验收。
46: 
47: 监督任务核实实际 Oracle 名称与调用结果，不擅自换模型，不用 Codex 自己审查冒充 Oracle。Oracle 不可用、调用失败或没有结论时记录 blocked；有阻塞问题时不通过。审查至少覆盖需求/任务清单、模块边界、API/数据库契约、权限、幂等与并发、恢复路径、测试证据和生产接入限制。只给 Oracle 相关设计及代码范围，监督任务只读精简报告，不搬运完整对话。
48: 
49: 报告保存 backend/handoffs/<包>-oracle.md，包含模块、审查代码 SHA、结论、问题严重度/位置/复现方式、修复与复审结果、残留限制。报告可以单独提交；必须标明被审查代码提交，后续代码变化需复审，纯报告提交不必循环审查自身。

142:     private SkinReportView project(AssessmentRepository.ReportRow row, String effectiveView,

145:         JsonNode payload = parsePayload(row.reportPayload());
146:         validateStructure(payload);
147:         String conclusion = textOrNull(payload.get("conclusion"));
148:         String description = full ? textOrNull(payload.get("description")) : null;
149:         List<Map<String, Object>> metrics = full ? projectMetrics(payload.get("metrics")) : null;
150:         List<SkinReportImage> images = projectImages(payload.get("images"));
151:         String memberId = full && row.memberId() != null ? row.memberId().toString() : null;
152:         String readyAt = row.reportReadyAt() == null ? null
153:                 : EnvelopeSupport.rfc3339(row.reportReadyAt());
154:         String planStatus = accessRepository.planStatusByAssessmentId(row.id()).orElse(null);

159:     private JsonNode parsePayload(String raw) {

162:         }
163:         try {
164:             JsonNode node = objectMapper.readTree(raw);
165:             if (node != null && node.isObject()) {

168:         } catch (Exception e) {

178:     private void validateStructure(JsonNode payload) {
179:         requireTextualOrNull(payload.get("conclusion"));
180:         requireTextualOrNull(payload.get("description"));

182:         requireArrayOrNull(payload.get("images"));

188:         }
189:     }

194:         }
195:     }

211:             return out;
212:         }

214:             if (!item.isObject()) {
215:                 continue;
216:             }

218:             copy(metric, "name", item.get("name"));

231:     }

21: /**
22:  * M3-A01/M3-A02 multipart 严格解析（DD 3.3/10.1；contracts M3A01Metadata/
23:  * M3A02Metadata）：metadata part（application/json，未知字段拒绝）+ 二进制
24:  * 图片 part。缺 part / 多 part / 非法字段一律 400 INVALID_INPUT；三图合计超
25:  * 限 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE。
26:  */
27: @Component
28: public class AssessmentMultipartParser {
29: 
30:     private static final Pattern BIGINT = Pattern.compile("^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$");
31:     private static final Set<String> VIEWS = Set.of("front", "left", "right");
32: 
33:     private final ObjectMapper mapper;
34:     private final long maxRequestBytes;
35: 
36:     public AssessmentMultipartParser(ObjectMapper mapper,
37:                                      @Value("${app.assessments.max-request-bytes:33554432}")
38:                                      long maxRequestBytes) {
39:         this.mapper = mapper;
40:         this.maxRequestBytes = maxRequestBytes;
41:     }
42: 
43:     public record A01Metadata(String photoVersion, String captureSessionId, String consentEvidenceRef) {
44:     }
45: 
46:     public record A02Metadata(String expectedPhotoVersion, List<String> replacedViews) {
47:     }
48: 
49:     public record ParsedA01(A01Metadata metadata, Map<String, byte[]> images) {
50:     }
51: 
52:     public record ParsedA02(A02Metadata metadata, Map<String, byte[]> images) {
53:     }
54: 
55:     public ParsedA01 parseA01(HttpServletRequest request) {
56:         RawParts raw = split(request);
57:         A01Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A01Metadata.class);
58:         if (!BIGINT.matcher(nullToEmpty(md.photoVersion())).matches() || !"1".equals(md.photoVersion())) {
59:             throw invalid("photoVersion must be the bigint string \"1\" for a new task");
60:         }
61:         requireText(md.captureSessionId(), "captureSessionId", 128);
62:         requireText(md.consentEvidenceRef(), "consentEvidenceRef", 128);
63:         Map<String, byte[]> images = requireExactViews(raw.imageParts(), VIEWS, "front,left,right");
64:         checkTotalSize(images);
65:         return new ParsedA01(md, images);
66:     }
67: 
68:     public ParsedA02 parseA02(HttpServletRequest request) {
69:         RawParts raw = split(request);
70:         A02Metadata md = readMetadata(raw.metadataBytes(), A02Metadata.class);
71:         if (md.expectedPhotoVersion() == null || !BIGINT.matcher(md.expectedPhotoVersion()).matches()) {
72:             throw invalid("expectedPhotoVersion must be a decimal bigint string");
73:         }
74:         List<String> replaced = md.replacedViews();
75:         if (replaced == null || replaced.isEmpty()) {
76:             throw invalid("replacedViews must be a non-empty list");
77:         }
78:         LinkedHashSet<String> requested = new LinkedHashSet<>();
79:         for (String view : replaced) {
80:             if (!VIEWS.contains(view)) {
81:                 throw invalid("replacedViews entries must be one of front,left,right");
82:             }
83:             requested.add(view);
84:         }
85:         if (requested.size() != replaced.size()) {
86:             throw invalid("replacedViews must be unique");
87:         }
88:         Map<String, byte[]> images = requireExactViews(raw.imageParts(), requested,
89:                 String.join(",", requested));
90:         checkTotalSize(images);
91:         return new ParsedA02(md, images);
92:     }
93: 
94:     private record RawParts(byte[] metadataBytes, Map<String, byte[]> imageParts) {
95:     }
96: 
97:     private RawParts split(HttpServletRequest request) {
98:         if (!(request instanceof MultipartHttpServletRequest multi)) {
99:             throw invalid("multipart/form-data request required");
100:         }
101:         Map<String, byte[]> parts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
102:         for (Map.Entry<String, MultipartFile> e : multi.getFileMap().entrySet()) {
103:             try {
104:                 parts.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue().getBytes());
105:             } catch (Exception ex) {
106:                 throw invalid("unreadable multipart part: " + e.getKey());
107:             }
108:         }
109:         byte[] metadata = parts.remove("metadata");
110:         if (metadata == null && multi.getParameter("metadata") != null) {
111:             metadata = multi.getParameter("metadata").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
112:         }
113:         if (metadata == null) {
114:             throw invalid("metadata part is required");
115:         }
116:         // 未声明的额外 multipart 文本参数同样拒绝（防未知字段静默成功）
117:         for (String name : multi.getParameterMap().keySet()) {
118:             if (!"metadata".equals(name)) {
119:                 throw invalid("unknown multipart field: " + name);
120:             }
121:         }
122:         return new RawParts(metadata, parts);
123:     }
124: 
125:     private Map<String, byte[]> requireExactViews(Map<String, byte[]> parts, Set<String> expected,
126:                                                   String label) {
127:         if (!parts.keySet().equals(expected)) {
128:             List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>(expected);
129:             missing.removeAll(parts.keySet());
130:             List<String> extra = new ArrayList<>(parts.keySet());
131:             extra.removeAll(expected);
132:             throw invalid("image parts must be exactly [" + label + "]; missing=" + missing
133:                     + " extra=" + extra);
134:         }
135:         return parts;
136:     }
137: 
138:     private void checkTotalSize(Map<String, byte[]> images) {
139:         long total = 0;
140:         for (byte[] b : images.values()) {
141:             total += b.length;
142:             if (total > maxRequestBytes) {
143:                 throw new ApiException(ErrorCode.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
144:                         "total image bytes exceed configured limit " + maxRequestBytes);
145:             }
146:         }
147:     }
148: 
149:     private <T> T readMetadata(byte[] bytes, Class<T> type) {
150:         try {
151:             return mapper.readValue(bytes, type);
152:         } catch (ApiException e) {
153:             throw e;
154:         } catch (Exception e) {
155:             throw invalid("metadata is not a valid " + type.getSimpleName());
156:         }
157:     }
158: 
159:     private static void requireText(String value, String field, int max) {
160:         if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
161:             throw invalid(field + " is required");
162:         }
163:         if (value.length() > max) {
164:             throw invalid(field + " exceeds max length " + max);
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     private static String nullToEmpty(String v) {
169:         return v == null ? "" : v;
170:     }
171: 
172:     private static ApiException invalid(String message) {
173:         return new ApiException(ErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT, message);
174:     }
175: }

418:     def _handle_reliable_new(
419:         self,
420:         ctx: HandlerContext,
421:         job: JobRow,
422:         dcfg: DConfig,
423:         assessment_id: str,
424:         rev: int,
425:         current_photo_version: int,

427:     ) -> Optional[HandlerResult]:
428:         ns = dcfg.identity_namespace
429:         candidate_id = candidate_entity_id(ns, assessment_id)
430:         correlation_id = enroll_correlation_id(ns, assessment_id)
431: 
432:         # 先持久化阶段（自有短事务、代次守卫），再做跨事务入队
433:         identity_result = {
434:             "schema_version": 1,
435:             "classification": "reliable_new",
436:             "candidate_entity_id": candidate_id,
437:             "phase": "enroll_pending",
438:             "correlation_id": correlation_id,
439:         }
440:         if not _persist_enroll_pending(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, identity_result):
441:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "analyze.enroll_persist_noop", **job.log_fields())
442:             return None
443: 
444:         payload = {
445:             "schema_version": 1,
446:             "correlation_id": correlation_id,
447:             "assessment_id": assessment_id,
448:             "photo_version": str(current_photo_version),
449:             "processing_revision": str(rev),
450:             "images": {
451:                 "front": media_ids["front"],
452:                 "left": media_ids["left"],
453:                 "right": media_ids["right"],
454:             },
455:             "provider_config_revision": dcfg.provider_config_revision,
456:         }
457:         try:
458:             enqueue_identity_enroll(
459:                 ctx.engine,
460:                 job_type="identity.enroll",
461:                 dedup_key=f"identity:{ns}:{candidate_id}",
462:                 owner_type="identity_namespace",
463:                 owner_id=namespace_owner_id(ns),
464:                 input_revision=rev,
465:                 payload=payload,
466:                 max_attempts=ctx.config.retry_max_attempts,
467:             )
468:         except EnrollSlotOccupied:
469:             # namespace 未决登记占满：本候选等待重搜（绝不并行登记第二份）
470:             pass
471: 
472:         # 无论新入队/重放/槽占用，本次分析都不能发布：等待登记完成后重搜命中。
473:         if job.attempt_count >= job.max_attempts:
474:             # 预算耗尽：登记协调项仍在（槽位保持占用），本任务落 failed 终态。
475:             _mark_failed(
476:                 ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_TIMEOUT",
477:                 "enrollment did not complete within attempt budget",
478:             )
479:             raise JobFailed(
480:                 "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_TIMEOUT",
481:                 "reliable new candidate enrollment timed out",
482:                 retryable=False,
483:             )
484:         raise JobFailed(
485:             "IDENTITY_ENROLLMENT_PENDING",
486:             "reliable new candidate awaiting enrollment",
487:             retryable=True,
488:         )

490:     def _retake_result(
491:         self,
492:         ctx: HandlerContext,
493:         job: JobRow,
494:         assessment_id: str,
495:         rev: int,
496:         *,
497:         classification: str,
498:         code: str,
499:         required_views: list[str],
500:         detail: str,
501:     ) -> HandlerResult:
502:         views = _bounded_views(required_views)
503:         identity_result = {
504:             "schema_version": 1,
505:             "classification": classification,
506:             "quality": {"status": "needs_retake", "required_views": views},
507:             "detail": detail[:200],
508:         }
509:         # failure_detail 仅内部诊断（裁定 3）：required_views 唯一权威通道 = identity_result.quality
510:         failure_detail = {"reason": detail[:200]}

60:         CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
61: ON CONFLICT (identity_namespace, face_subject_ref)
62:     WHERE identity_namespace IS NOT NULL AND face_subject_ref IS NOT NULL
63: DO NOTHING
64: RETURNING id

66: )

85: class IdentityEnrollHandler:
86:     name = "identity-enroll"
87: 
88:     def __init__(self) -> None:
89:         self._validator = None
90:         self._lock = threading.Lock()
91: 
92:     def _get_validator(self):
93:         if self._validator is None:
94:             with self._lock:
95:                 if self._validator is None:
96:                     self._validator = load_payload_validator(_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA)
97:         return self._validator
98: 
99:     def validate(self, payload: object) -> None:

102:     def handle(self, ctx: HandlerContext, job: JobRow) -> Optional[HandlerResult]:
103:         assessment_id = str(job.payload["assessment_id"])
104:         rev = int(job.payload["processing_revision"])
105:         photo_version = int(job.payload["photo_version"])
106:         correlation_id = str(job.payload["correlation_id"])
107:         dcfg = dconfig_for(ctx)

109: 
110:         row = _load_assessment(ctx.engine, assessment_id)

114:         # 输入已被补拍替换 → 不调用供应商、不归属旧结果（DD 9.3）
115:         if (
116:             int(row["processing_revision"]) != rev
117:             or int(row["current_photo_version"]) != photo_version
118:         ):
119:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "enroll.stale_input", **job.log_fields())
120:             return None
121: 
122:         media_ids = {
123:             "front": str(job.payload["images"]["front"]),
124:             "left": str(job.payload["images"]["left"]),
125:             "right": str(job.payload["images"]["right"]),
126:         }
127:         images = load_image_bytes(ctx.engine, storage_for(ctx), media_ids)
128:         if isinstance(images, str):
129:             self._transient_or_terminal(
130:                 ctx, job, code="SOURCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
131:                 message="enrollment source image unavailable", reason=images,
132:             )
133:             return None  # pragma: no cover
134: 
135:         candidate_id = candidate_entity_id(ns, assessment_id)
136:         request_id = provider_request_id(correlation_id)
137: 
138:         # 2) 外部调用前先持久记录阶段（可恢复/可对账）
139:         started = {
140:             "schema_version": 1,
141:             "classification": "reliable_new",
142:             "candidate_entity_id": candidate_id,
143:             "phase": "enroll_started",
144:             "correlation_id": correlation_id,
145:             "provider_request_id": request_id,
146:         }
147:         if not _persist_started(ctx.engine, assessment_id, rev, started):
148:             mlog(log, logging.INFO, "enroll.persist_started_noop", **job.log_fields())
149:             return None
150: 
151:         face = face_port_for(ctx)
152:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
153:             return None
154: 
155:         # 3) 外部登记（锁外）；超时/未知 → 同 EntityId 对账，绝不生成另一 ID 盲重试
156:         try:
157:             registered = face.register_person(
158:                 ns, candidate_id, images, correlation_id, request_id
159:             )
160:         except ProviderUnavailable:
161:             return self._reconcile(
162:                 ctx, job, face, ns, candidate_id, correlation_id, request_id
163:             )
164: 
165:         status = getattr(registered, "status", "failed")
166:         if status in ("success", "timeout", "unknown"):
167:             visible = face.query_registration(
168:                 correlation_id, request_id, namespace=ns, entity_id=candidate_id
169:             )
170:             if getattr(visible, "status", None) != "registered":
171:                 self._transient_or_terminal(
172:                     ctx, job, code="ENROLLMENT_RECONCILE_PENDING",
173:                     message="registration not confirmed visible",

175:                 )

179:                 ctx, job, code="ENROLLMENT_FAILED",

181:             )
182:             return None  # pragma: no cover
183: 
184:         identity_summary = _identity_summary(

188:             assessment_id=assessment_id,

193:             business_tx=lambda conn: _commit_enrollment(
194:                 conn,
195:                 assessment_id=assessment_id,
196:                 rev=rev,
197:                 photo_version=photo_version,
198:                 namespace=ns,
199:                 candidate_id=candidate_id,
200:                 correlation_id=correlation_id,
201:                 identity_summary=identity_summary,
202:             )
203:         )

208:         self,
209:         ctx: HandlerContext,
210:         job: JobRow,
211:         face: Any,
212:         ns: str,
213:         candidate_id: str,
214:         correlation_id: str,
215:         request_id: str,

226:             )

229:             self._transient_or_terminal(

232:                 reason="provider registration not confirmed",
233:             )
234:             return None  # pragma: no cover
235:         # 对账确认已登记 → 走正常归属（不重新调用 register_person）
236:         dcfg = dconfig_for(ctx)
237:         media_ids = {

239:             "left": str(job.payload["images"]["left"]),
240:             "right": str(job.payload["images"]["right"]),
241:         }
242:         identity_summary = _identity_summary(
243:             correlation_id=correlation_id,

246:             assessment_id=str(job.payload["assessment_id"]),

252:                 conn,

254:                 rev=int(job.payload["processing_revision"]),
255:                 photo_version=int(job.payload["photo_version"]),

<type>file</type>
<content>
1: """``media.cleanup``：仅清理明确无引用的失败/未被接纳上传（DD 10.3，裁定 5）。
2: 
3: 只做状态迁移 + 存储对象删除，**永不 DELETE T11 行**；不使用任何 TTL；绝不清理
4: 已归属/被业务引用的对象。锁顺序（DD 10.3）：先做 T13 处理者活性与业务引用核查
5: （单表只读、不过早持 T11 行锁），后进入两段式 ``deleting →（锁外存储删除，幂等）
6: → deleted``；崩溃/重跑可从 ``deleting`` 恢复。本 handler 不写任何其它表。
7: """
8: from __future__ import annotations
9: 
10: import logging
11: import threading
12: from typing import Any, Optional
13: 
14: from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
15: 
16: from ..logging_setup import mlog
17: from ..runtime.rows import JobRow
18: from . import HandlerContext, HandlerResult, JobFailed
19: from .dshared.denqueue import enqueue_job
20: from .dshared.jsonschema_support import load_payload_validator, validate_payload
21: from .dshared.resolve import storage_for
22: 
23: log = logging.getLogger("mvp_worker.handlers.media_cleanup")
24: 
25: JOB_TYPE = "media.cleanup"
26: _PAYLOAD_SCHEMA = "payload-media-cleanup.json"
27: 
28: _SELECT_MEDIA = text(
29:     """
30: SELECT id, bucket, object_key, purpose, state, assessment_id, execution_id,
31:        member_id, request_id
32: FROM media_objects
33: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
34: """
35: )
36: 
37: # T13 处理者活性（单表只读；先于任何 T11 锁）
38: _SELECT_PROCESSOR_ACTIVE = text(
39:     """
40: SELECT (status = 'processing' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL
41:         AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
42: FROM idempotency_requests
43: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
44: """
45: )
46: 
47: # 业务引用文本包含扫描（单表 EXISTS，MVP 规模可接受，无 JOIN）
48: _REF_SKIN_ASSESSMENTS = text(
49:     """
50: SELECT EXISTS (
51:   SELECT 1 FROM skin_assessments
52:   WHERE CAST(photo_versions AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
53:      OR CAST(report_payload AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
54: )
55: """
56: )
57: 
58: _REF_MEMBERS = text(
59:     """
60: SELECT EXISTS (
61:   SELECT 1 FROM members
62:   WHERE CAST(identity_summary AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
63: )
64: """
65: )
66: 
67: _REF_CARE_EXECUTIONS = text(
68:     """
69: SELECT EXISTS (
70:   SELECT 1 FROM care_executions
71:   WHERE CAST(latest_verification AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
72:      OR CAST(plan_snapshot AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
73:      OR CAST(closure_manifest AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
74: )
75: """
76: )
77: 
78: _REF_IDEMPOTENCY = text(
79:     """
80: SELECT EXISTS (
81:   SELECT 1 FROM idempotency_requests
82:   WHERE CAST(verification_summary AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
83:      OR CAST(result_summary AS text) LIKE '%' || :media_id || '%'
84: )
85: """
86: )
87: 
88: # tx-A：原子占位 deleting（仅无归属可清理行）
89: _MARK_DELETING = text(
90:     """
91: UPDATE media_objects
92: SET state = 'deleting', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
93: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
94:   AND state IN ('pending', 'available', 'failed')
95:   AND assessment_id IS NULL AND execution_id IS NULL AND member_id IS NULL
96: """
97: )
98: 
99: # tx-B：确认已删除（不触碰 storage_metadata）
100: _MARK_DELETED = text(
101:     """
102: UPDATE media_objects
103: SET state = 'deleted', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
104: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid) AND state = 'deleting'
105: """
106: )
107: 
108: # 有界候选扫描：无归属可清理的孤儿（单表；不含 TTL，无 JOIN）
109: _SELECT_ORPHAN_CANDIDATES = text(
110:     """
111: SELECT id, bucket, object_key, purpose, state, request_id,
112:        assessment_id, execution_id, member_id
113: FROM media_objects
114: WHERE state IN ('pending', 'available', 'failed')
115:   AND assessment_id IS NULL AND execution_id IS NULL AND member_id IS NULL
116: ORDER BY created_at, id
117: LIMIT :limit
118: """
119: )
120: 
121: # 发现入队使用的确定性修订（无业务代次时固定 1，保证 dedup 幂等）
122: _DISCOVERY_REVISION = 1
123: 
124: 
125: class MediaCleanupHandler:
126:     name = "media-cleanup"
127: 
128:     def __init__(self) -> None:
129:         self._validator = None
130:         self._lock = threading.Lock()
131: 
132:     def _get_validator(self):
133:         if self._validator is None:
134:             with self._lock:
135:                 if self._validator is None:
136:                     self._validator = load_payload_validator(_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA)
137:         return self._validator
138: 
139:     def validate(self, payload: object) -> None:
140:         validate_payload(self._get_validator(), payload, _PAYLOAD_SCHEMA)
141: 
142:     def handle(self, ctx: HandlerContext, job: JobRow) -> Optional[HandlerResult]:
143:         media_id = str(job.payload["media_object_id"])
144: 
145:         row = _load_media(ctx.engine, media_id)
146:         if row is None:
147:             return None  # 行不存在：已无对象可清，no-op 成功
148:         state = row["state"]
149:         if state == "deleted":
150:             return None  # 已删除：幂等 no-op 成功
151: 
152:         if state != "deleting":
153:             # 2) 范围守卫：只清失败行或未被接纳的无归属上传
154:             if not _cleanable(row):
155:                 mlog(
156:                     log, logging.ERROR, "media.cleanup.referenced_or_owned",
157:                     **job.log_fields(), mediaId=media_id, media_state=state,
158:                 )
159:                 raise JobFailed(
160:                     "MEDIA_REFERENCED", "media object is owned or accepted", retryable=False
161:                 )
162:             # 3) 处理者活性 + 业务引用核查（先于任何 T11 锁）
163:             request_id = row["request_id"]
164:             if request_id is not None and _processor_active(ctx.engine, str(request_id)):
165:                 raise JobFailed(
166:                     "PROCESSOR_ACTIVE", "ingest processor lease still active", retryable=True
167:                 )
168:             if _referenced(ctx.engine, media_id):
169:                 mlog(
170:                     log, logging.ERROR, "media.cleanup.referenced",
171:                     **job.log_fields(), mediaId=media_id,
172:                 )
173:                 raise JobFailed(
174:                     "MEDIA_REFERENCED", "media object is referenced by business data",
175:                     retryable=False,
176:                 )
177:             # 4) tx-A：原子进入 deleting（0 行 → 重读判定）
178:             if not _mark_deleting(ctx.engine, media_id):
179:                 again = _load_media(ctx.engine, media_id)
180:                 if again is None or again["state"] == "deleted":
181:                     return None
182:                 if not _ownership_null(again):
183:                     mlog(
184:                         log, logging.ERROR, "media.cleanup.referenced_after_guard",
185:                         **job.log_fields(), mediaId=media_id,
186:                     )
187:                     raise JobFailed(
188:                         "MEDIA_REFERENCED", "media object became owned/referenced",
189:                         retryable=False,
190:                     )
191:                 raise JobFailed(
192:                     "CLEANUP_CONTENDED", "media cleanup concurrently progressing",
193:                     retryable=True,
194:                 )
195: 
196:         # 4) 锁外存储删除（幂等：对象不存在视为已删除）
197:         if ctx.abort_event.is_set():
198:             return None
199:         _delete_object(storage_for(ctx), str(row["object_key"]))
200: 
201:         # tx-B：确认 deleted（0 行 → 并发操作，no-op）
202:         return HandlerResult(
203:             business_tx=lambda conn: _mark_deleted(conn, media_id)
204:         )
205: 
206: 
207: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- module helpers
208: 
209: 
210: def _load_media(engine: Engine, media_id: str) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
211:     with engine.connect() as conn:
212:         row = conn.execute(_SELECT_MEDIA, {"id": media_id}).mappings().first()
213:     return dict(row) if row is not None else None
214: 
215: 
216: def _cleanable(row: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
217:     state = row["state"]
218:     if state == "failed":
219:         return True
220:     if state in ("pending", "available"):
221:         return _ownership_null(row)
222:     return False
223: 
224: 
225: def _ownership_null(row: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
226:     return (
227:         row["assessment_id"] is None
228:         and row["execution_id"] is None
229:         and row["member_id"] is None
230:     )
231: 
232: 
233: def _processor_active(engine: Engine, request_id: str) -> bool:
234:     with engine.connect() as conn:
235:         value = conn.execute(
236:             _SELECT_PROCESSOR_ACTIVE, {"id": request_id}
237:         ).scalar_one_or_none()
238:     return bool(value)
239: 
240: 
241: def _referenced(engine: Engine, media_id: str) -> bool:
242:     with engine.connect() as conn:
243:         for stmt in (
244:             _REF_SKIN_ASSESSMENTS,
245:             _REF_MEMBERS,
246:             _REF_CARE_EXECUTIONS,
247:             _REF_IDEMPOTENCY,
248:         ):
249:             if bool(conn.execute(stmt, {"media_id": media_id}).scalar_one()):
250:                 return True
251:     return False
252: 
253: 
254: def _mark_deleting(engine: Engine, media_id: str) -> bool:
255:     with engine.begin() as conn:
256:         res = conn.execute(_MARK_DELETING, {"id": media_id})
257:     return res.rowcount > 0
258: 
259: 
260: def _mark_deleted(conn: Connection, media_id: str) -> None:
261:     conn.execute(_MARK_DELETED, {"id": media_id})
262: 
263: 
264: def _delete_object(storage: Any, object_key: str) -> None:
265:     """锁外删除对象；对象不存在视为已删除，其它错误可重试（行保持 deleting）。"""
266:     try:
267:         storage.delete(object_key)
268:         return
269:     except Exception:
270:         try:
271:             if not storage.exists(object_key):
272:                 return  # 对象已不存在：幂等恢复
273:         except Exception:
274:             pass
275:         raise JobFailed(
276:             "STORAGE_DELETE_FAILED", "object storage delete failed", retryable=True
277:         )
278: 
279: 
280: def discover_and_enqueue_orphans(engine: Engine, *, limit: int = 100) -> int:
281:     """有界扫描无归属孤儿并**幂等**入队 ``media.cleanup``；返回新入队任务数。
282: 
283:     覆盖 crash-after-ingest 形态（T13 succeeded/rejected/过期 processing + 未被
284:     受理的 T11 行 + 已落存储对象）。复用 handler 的安全证明：处理者活跃租约、
285:     任一业务引用包含命中 → 不删也不入队。dedup ``media:{id}:cleanup:1`` 保证
286:     重复发现不产生新任务。无新表、无 TTL、不周期接入（周期接入归总协调）。
287:     """
288:     enqueued = 0
289:     with engine.connect() as conn:
290:         rows = conn.execute(
291:             _SELECT_ORPHAN_CANDIDATES, {"limit": int(limit)}
292:         ).mappings().all()
293:     for row in rows:
294:         media_id = str(row["id"])
295:         candidate = dict(row)
296:         if not _cleanable(candidate):
297:             continue
298:         request_id = candidate["request_id"]
299:         if request_id is not None and _processor_active(engine, str(request_id)):
300:             continue  # 处理者租约仍活跃：安全证明不足，跳过
301:         if _referenced(engine, media_id):
302:             continue  # 任一业务引用包含命中：不删不入队
303:         _, replayed = enqueue_job(
304:             engine,
305:             job_type=JOB_TYPE,
306:             dedup_key=f"media:{media_id}:cleanup:{_DISCOVERY_REVISION}",
307:             owner_type="media",
308:             owner_id=media_id,
309:             input_revision=_DISCOVERY_REVISION,
310:             payload={
311:                 "schema_version": 1,
312:                 "media_object_id": media_id,
313:                 "cleanup_revision": str(_DISCOVERY_REVISION),
314:             },
315:         )
316:         if not replayed:
317:             enqueued += 1
318:     return enqueued
319: 
320: 
321: handler = MediaCleanupHandler()

<content>
1: """供应商端口 + 可控替身 + 阿里云形状边界 + 工厂（生产 fail-closed）。
2: 
3: 设计要点（DD 9.3 / 人脸调研 §4）：
4: 
5: - 端口是 Protocol：``FacePort`` / ``SkinPort`` / ``PlanPort``；handler 只依赖端口，
6:   测试注入 ``*Double``，生产由阿里云适配器替换。
7: - 替身确定性、可注错（fault injection），只产生合成数据，绝不产生虚假业务因果。
8: - 工厂从 env 解析（``MVP_D_*_PROVIDER``）；``environment == 'production'`` 且解析为
9:   ``double`` 时**立即抛错**，替身永不进生产。
10: - 阿里云适配器实现了与调研文档一致的**方法边界与配置读取**，但在没有总协调授权
11:   凭据 + PoC 时每个调用都抛 :class:`ProviderNotActivated`（映射为可重试
12:   DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE），**不伪造结果、不产生虚假业务效果**。
13: """
14: from __future__ import annotations
15: 
16: import base64
17: from dataclasses import dataclass
18: from typing import Any, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable
19: 
20: from .dconfig import (
21:     DEFAULT_PLAN_CAPABILITY_BASELINE,
22:     DConfig,
23: )
24: 
25: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- errors
26: 
27: 
28: class ProviderUnavailable(RuntimeError):
29:     """瞬时依赖不可用（网络/超时/5xx）→ handler 映射为可重试失败。"""
30: 
31: 
32: class ProviderNotActivated(ProviderUnavailable):
33:     """适配器尚未真实激活（无授权凭据/未过 PoC）→ 可重试，不伪造结果。"""
34: 
35: 
36: class ProviderConfigError(RuntimeError):
37:     """配置错误（如生产环境解析到替身）。"""
38: 
39: 
40: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- result values
41: 
42: 
43: @dataclass(frozen=True)
44: class QualityResult:
45:     status: str  # accepted | needs_retake
46:     required_views: tuple[str, ...] = ()
47: 
48: 
49: @dataclass(frozen=True)
50: class SamePersonResult:
51:     ok: bool
52: 
53: 
54: @dataclass(frozen=True)
55: class SearchResult:
56:     classification: str  # matched | uncertain | ambiguous | reliable_new
57:     face_subject_ref: Optional[str] = None
58: 
59: 
60: @dataclass(frozen=True)
61: class RegisterResult:
62:     status: str  # success | timeout | unknown | failed
63: 
64: 
65: @dataclass(frozen=True)
66: class RegistrationQueryResult:
67:     status: str  # registered | not_found | unknown
68: 
69: 
70: @dataclass(frozen=True)
71: class SkinAnalysisResult:
72:     conclusion: str
73:     metrics: list[dict[str, Any]]
74:     description: str
75:     result_images: list[dict[str, Any]]  # {ref, bytes|provider_uri, caption}
76:     model_version: str
77: 
78: 
79: @dataclass
80: class PlanCandidate:
81:     description: str
82:     steps: list[dict[str, Any]]
83:     target_count: Any  # 故意宽松：由 handler 严格校验（可能注入非法形状）
84:     model_version: str
85: 
86: 
87: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- ports
88: 
89: 
90: @runtime_checkable
91: class FacePort(Protocol):
92:     provider_name: str
93:     model_version: str
94: 
95:     def quality(self, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> QualityResult: ...
96:     def same_person(self, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> SamePersonResult: ...
97:     def search_1n(self, namespace: str, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> SearchResult: ...
98:     def register_person(
99:         self,
100:         namespace: str,
101:         entity_id: str,
102:         images: dict[str, bytes],
103:         correlation_id: str,
104:         provider_request_id: str,
105:     ) -> RegisterResult: ...
106:     def query_registration(
107:         self,
108:         correlation_id: str,
109:         provider_request_id: str,
110:         *,
111:         namespace: Optional[str] = None,
112:         entity_id: Optional[str] = None,
113:     ) -> RegistrationQueryResult: ...
114: 
115: 
116: @runtime_checkable
117: class SkinPort(Protocol):
118:     provider_name: str
119:     model_version: str
120: 
121:     def analyze(self, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> SkinAnalysisResult: ...
122: 
123: 
124: @runtime_checkable
125: class PlanPort(Protocol):
126:     provider_name: str
127:     model_version: str
128: 
129:     def generate(
130:         self, report_context: dict[str, Any], input_snapshot: dict[str, Any]
131:     ) -> PlanCandidate: ...
132: 
133: 
134: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- fault helper
135: 
136: 
137: class _FaultInjector:
138:     """按方法名预置异常队列：测试可让第 N 次外部调用抛指定异常。"""
139: 
140:     def __init__(self, faults: Optional[dict[str, list[BaseException]]] = None) -> None:
141:         self._faults: dict[str, list[BaseException]] = {
142:             k: list(v) for k, v in (faults or {}).items()
143:         }
144: 
145:     def maybe_raise(self, method: str) -> None:
146:         pending = self._faults.get(method)
147:         if pending:
148:             raise pending.pop(0)
149: 
150: 
151: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- doubles
152: 
153: _ONE_PX_PNG = base64.b64decode(
154:     "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="
155: )
156: 
157: 
158: class FaceDouble:
159:     """确定性人脸替身；测试可注入 search 分类、登记/对账行为与瞬时异常。"""
160: 
161:     provider_name = "double"
162:     model_version = "face-double-1"
163: 
164:     def __init__(
165:         self,
166:         *,
167:         search: str = "reliable_new",
168:         face_subject_ref: Optional[str] = None,
169:         same_person: bool = True,
170:         quality: str = "accepted",
171:         required_views: Optional[tuple[str, ...]] = None,
172:         register: str = "success",
173:         query: str = "registered",
174:         faults: Optional[dict[str, list[BaseException]]] = None,
175:     ) -> None:
176:         self._search = search
177:         self._face_subject_ref = face_subject_ref
178:         self._same_person = same_person
179:         self._quality = quality
180:         self._required_views = required_views
181:         self._register = register
182:         self._query = query
183:         self._faults = _FaultInjector(faults)
184:         self.calls: dict[str, int] = {}
185:         self.registered: dict[str, str] = {}
186: 
187:     def _tick(self, method: str) -> None:
188:         self.calls[method] = self.calls.get(method, 0) + 1
189: 
190:     def quality(self, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> QualityResult:
191:         self._tick("quality")
192:         self._faults.maybe_raise("quality")
193:         if self._quality == "needs_retake":
194:             views = tuple(self._required_views) if self._required_views else ("front",)
195:             return QualityResult("needs_retake", views)
196:         return QualityResult("accepted", ())
197: 
198:     def same_person(self, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> SamePersonResult:
199:         self._tick("same_person")
200:         self._faults.maybe_raise("same_person")
201:         return SamePersonResult(bool(self._same_person))
202: 
203:     def search_1n(self, namespace: str, images: dict[str, bytes]) -> SearchResult:
204:         self._tick("search_1n")
205:         self._faults.maybe_raise("search_1n")
206:         if namespace in self.registered:
207:             return SearchResult("matched", self.registered[namespace])
208:         if self._search == "dependency_failed":
209:             raise ProviderUnavailable("face search unavailable")
210:         if self._search == "matched":
211:             return SearchResult("matched", self._face_subject_ref)
212:         return SearchResult(self._search)
213: 
214:     def register_person(
215:         self,
216:         namespace: str,
217:         entity_id: str,
218:         images: dict[str, bytes],
219:         correlation_id: str,
220:         provider_request_id: str,
221:     ) -> RegisterResult:
222:         self._tick("register_person")
223:         self._faults.maybe_raise("register_person")
224:         if self._register == "success":
225:             self.registered[namespace] = entity_id
226:             return RegisterResult("success")
227:         if self._register == "timeout":
228:             return RegisterResult("timeout")
229:         if self._register == "unknown":
230:             return RegisterResult("unknown")
231:         return RegisterResult("failed")
232: 
233:     def query_registration(
234:         self,
235:         correlation_id: str,
236:         provider_request_id: str,
237:         *,
238:         namespace: Optional[str] = None,
239:         entity_id: Optional[str] = None,
240:     ) -> RegistrationQueryResult:
241:         self._tick("query_registration")
242:         self._faults.maybe_raise("query_registration")
243:         if self._query == "registered":
244:             if namespace is not None and entity_id is not None:

1: """结果图归档：算法输出图 → 受控 T11 ``assessment_result`` 行 + 存储对象。
2: 
3: 流程（DD 9.4 / 10.1）：先按 ``assessment_id + photo_version + purpose`` 单表读取
4: 既有结果图，用 ``storage_metadata->>'provider_ref'`` 匹配复用（至少一次重跑不产生
5: 孤儿重复）；否则插 pending 行 → 存储 put（事务外）→ 置 available（内容类型/大小/
6: 摘要）。任何归档失败都**不发布报告**，由 handler 决定可重试或终止。
7: """
8: from __future__ import annotations
9: 
10: import hashlib
11: import json
12: import uuid
13: from typing import Any, Optional
14: 
15: from sqlalchemy import Engine, text
16: 
17: from ...media.storage import build_object_key
18: from .constants import ALLOWED_RESULT_CONTENT_TYPES, DEFAULT_BUCKET
19: 
20: _SELECT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
21:     """
22: SELECT id, object_key, state, content_type, byte_size, storage_metadata
23: FROM media_objects
24: WHERE assessment_id = CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid)
25:   AND photo_version = :photo_version
26:   AND purpose = 'assessment_result'
27: """
28: )
29: 
30: _INSERT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
31:     """
32: INSERT INTO media_objects (id, bucket, object_key, purpose, assessment_id, photo_version,
33:                            member_id, uploader_type, state, storage_metadata,
34:                            created_at, updated_at)
35: VALUES (CAST(:id AS uuid), :bucket, :object_key, 'assessment_result',
36:         CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid), :photo_version, NULL, 'worker', 'pending',
37:         CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
38: """
39: )
40: 
41: _UPDATE_MEDIA_AVAILABLE = text(
42:     """
43: UPDATE media_objects
44: SET state = 'available', content_type = :content_type, byte_size = :byte_size,
45:     content_hash = :content_hash, storage_metadata = CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb),
46:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
47: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid) AND state IN ('pending', 'available')
48: """
49: )
50: 
51: 
52: _SELECT_SOURCE_MEDIA = text(
53:     "SELECT id, object_key, state FROM media_objects WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)"
54: )
55: 
56: 
57: class ArchiveError(RuntimeError):
58:     """结果图归档失败；``terminal`` 表示重试无法恢复。"""
59: 
60:     def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, *, terminal: bool) -> None:
61:         super().__init__(f"{code}: {message}")
62:         self.code = code
63:         self.message = message
64:         self.terminal = terminal
65: 
66: 
67: def sniff_content_type(data: bytes) -> Optional[str]:
68:     if data.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"):
69:         return "image/png"
70:     if data.startswith(b"\xff\xd8\xff"):
71:         return "image/jpeg"
72:     if data[:4] == b"RIFF" and data[8:12] == b"WEBP":
73:         return "image/webp"
74:     return None
75: 
76: 
77: def _load_by_ref(engine: Engine, assessment_id: str, photo_version: int) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
78:     with engine.connect() as conn:
79:         rows = conn.execute(
80:             _SELECT_RESULT_MEDIA,
81:             {"assessment_id": assessment_id, "photo_version": int(photo_version)},
82:         ).mappings().all()
83:     by_ref: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
84:     for row in rows:
85:         meta = row["storage_metadata"] or {}
86:         ref = meta.get("provider_ref") if isinstance(meta, dict) else None
87:         if isinstance(ref, str) and ref and ref not in by_ref:
88:             by_ref[ref] = dict(row)
89:     return by_ref
90: 
91: 
92: def archive_result_images(
93:     engine: Engine,
94:     storage: Any,
95:     *,
96:     environment: str,
97:     assessment_id: str,
98:     photo_version: int,
99:     result_images: list[dict[str, Any]],
100:     max_bytes: int,
101: ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
102:     """归档结果图；返回 ``[{"media_id","caption","content_type"}]``（保序）。"""
103:     by_ref = _load_by_ref(engine, assessment_id, photo_version)
104:     archived: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
105: 
106:     for image in result_images:
107:         if not isinstance(image, dict):
108:             raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image not an object", terminal=True)
109:         ref = image.get("ref")
110:         caption = image.get("caption", "")
111:         data = image.get("bytes")
112:         if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
113:             raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image missing ref", terminal=True)
114:         if not isinstance(caption, str):
115:             raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image caption not a string", terminal=True)
116:         if not isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
117:             raise ArchiveError(
118:                 "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image bytes missing", terminal=True
119:             )
120:         data = bytes(data)
121:         if len(data) > int(max_bytes):
122:             raise ArchiveError("RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image exceeds size cap", terminal=True)
123:         content_type = sniff_content_type(data)
124:         if content_type not in ALLOWED_RESULT_CONTENT_TYPES:
125:             raise ArchiveError(
126:                 "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "result image content type not allowed", terminal=True
127:             )
128: 
129:         existing = by_ref.get(ref)
130:         if (
131:             existing is not None
132:             and existing.get("state") == "available"
133:             and existing.get("content_type") == content_type
134:             and existing.get("byte_size") == len(data)
135:         ):
136:             archived.append(
137:                 {"media_id": str(existing["id"]), "caption": caption, "content_type": content_type}
138:             )
139:             continue
140: 
141:         if existing is None:
142:             media_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
143:             object_key = build_object_key(environment, "assessment_result", media_id)
144:             meta = {"schema_version": 1, "provider_ref": ref}
145:             with engine.begin() as conn:
146:                 conn.execute(
147:                     _INSERT_RESULT_MEDIA,
148:                     {
149:                         "id": media_id,
150:                         "bucket": DEFAULT_BUCKET,
151:                         "object_key": object_key,
152:                         "assessment_id": assessment_id,
153:                         "photo_version": int(photo_version),
154:                         "storage_metadata": _json(meta),
155:                     },
156:                 )
157:             row = {
158:                 "id": media_id,
159:                 "object_key": object_key,
160:                 "state": "pending",
161:                 "content_type": None,
162:                 "byte_size": None,
163:                 "storage_metadata": meta,
164:             }
165:             by_ref[ref] = row
166:             existing = row
167:         else:
168:             media_id = str(existing["id"])
169:             object_key = str(existing["object_key"])
170: 
171:         try:
172:             storage.put(object_key, data)
173:         except Exception as exc:  # 存储瞬时不可用 → 可重试；pending 行保留待复用
174:             raise ArchiveError(
175:                 "RESULT_ARCHIVE_FAILED", "storage put failed", terminal=False
176:             ) from exc
177: 
178:         meta = {"schema_version": 1, "provider_ref": ref}
179:         digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
180:         with engine.begin() as conn:
181:             conn.execute(
182:                 _UPDATE_MEDIA_AVAILABLE,
183:                 {
184:                     "id": media_id,
185:                     "content_type": content_type,
186:                     "byte_size": len(data),
187:                     "content_hash": digest,
188:                     "storage_metadata": _json(meta),
189:                 },
190:             )
191:         existing.update({"state": "available", "content_type": content_type, "byte_size": len(data)})
192:         archived.append({"media_id": media_id, "caption": caption, "content_type": content_type})
193: 
194:     return archived
195: 
196: 
197: def _json(value: Any) -> str:
198:     return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
199: 
200: 
201: def load_image_bytes(
202:     engine: Engine, storage: Any, media_ids: dict[str, str]
203: ) -> "dict[str, bytes] | str":
204:     """按 media_id 读取各视角对象字节；失败返回原因字符串（保持单表读、无 JOIN）。"""
205:     out: dict[str, bytes] = {}
206:     for view, media_id in media_ids.items():
207:         with engine.connect() as conn:
208:             row = conn.execute(_SELECT_SOURCE_MEDIA, {"id": media_id}).mappings().first()
209:         if row is None:
210:             return f"media row missing for view {view}"
211:         if row["state"] != "available":
212:             return f"media not available for view {view}"
213:         try:
214:             out[view] = storage.get(str(row["object_key"]))
215:         except Exception:  # 存储瞬时不可读 → 可重试
216:             return f"storage read failed for view {view}"
217:     return out

4: 未注入时按 :class:`DConfig` + ``WorkerConfig.environment`` 构建；生产环境解析到替身或
5: 阿里云适配器未激活 → 映射为可重试 ``DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE``（fail-closed）。

18:     ProviderConfigError,
19:     ProviderNotActivated,
20:     ProviderUnavailable,
21: )

23: 
24: def dconfig_for(ctx: HandlerContext) -> DConfig:
25:     injected = ctx.extras.get("dconfig")
26:     if injected is not None:
27:         return injected
28:     return DConfig.from_env()

33:         "DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE",

39: def face_port_for(ctx: HandlerContext) -> Any:

42:         return injected

44:         return build_face_port(dconfig_for(ctx), environment=ctx.config.environment)
45:     except (ProviderConfigError, ProviderNotActivated, ProviderUnavailable) as exc:
46:         raise _dependency_failed("face", exc) from exc

49: def skin_port_for(ctx: HandlerContext) -> Any:
50:     injected = ctx.extras.get("skin_port")
51:     if injected is not None:
52:         return injected
53:     try:

1: """Worker 侧 T12 入队助手（去重语义 + 部分唯一索引冲突区分）。
2: 
3: - ``insert_job`` 在调用方事务内执行（供 business_tx 与后继任务同事务提交）；
4: - ``enqueue_job`` 自开短事务（供跨事务阶段，如 identity.enroll 触发）；
5: - ``enqueue_identity_enroll`` 额外把 ``uq_job_identity_enroll`` 冲突翻译为
6:   :class:`EnrollSlotOccupied`（namespace 级未决登记占满 → 候选等待重搜）。
7: 
8: payload 一律 dict 且 ``schema_version`` 必须为 JSON 整数（T12 CHECK 要求 object 且
9: ``schema_version`` 为 number）。
10: """
11: from __future__ import annotations
12: 
13: import json
14: from typing import Any, Optional
15: 
16: from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
17: from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
18: 
19: from ...config import WorkerConfig
20: 
21: _INSERT_JOB = text(
22:     """
23: INSERT INTO async_jobs (id, job_type, dedup_key, owner_type, owner_id, input_revision,
24:                         payload, status, available_at, attempt_count, max_attempts,
25:                         lease_revision, created_at, updated_at)
26: VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), :job_type, :dedup_key, :owner_type, CAST(:owner_id AS uuid),
27:         :input_revision, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), 'queued',
28:         CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :delay_seconds),
29:         0, :max_attempts, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
30: ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
31: RETURNING id
32: """
33: )
34: 
35: _SELECT_BY_DEDUP = text("SELECT id FROM async_jobs WHERE dedup_key = :dedup_key")
36: 
37: 
38: class EnrollSlotOccupied(RuntimeError):
39:     """namespace 级 identity.enroll 未决槽已被占用（uq_job_identity_enroll）。"""
40: 
41: 
42: def _is_enroll_slot_conflict(exc: IntegrityError) -> bool:
43:     orig = getattr(exc, "orig", None)
44:     diag = getattr(orig, "diag", None)
45:     name = getattr(diag, "constraint_name", None) if diag is not None else None
46:     if name == "uq_job_identity_enroll":
47:         return True
48:     return "uq_job_identity_enroll" in str(exc)
49: 
50: 
51: def insert_job(
52:     conn: Connection,
53:     *,
54:     job_type: str,
55:     dedup_key: str,
56:     owner_type: str,
57:     owner_id: str,
58:     input_revision: int,
59:     payload: dict[str, Any],
60:     available_at_delay_seconds: float = 0.0,
61:     max_attempts: Optional[int] = None,
62: ) -> tuple[str, bool]:
63:     """在调用方事务内插入（或按 dedup_key 复用）一行 queued 任务。
64: 
65:     返回 ``(job_id, replayed)``：dedup 冲突 = 同一逻辑任务重放（不是错误）。
66:     可能向上抛 ``IntegrityError``（如 identity 部分唯一索引）；调用方决定语义。
67:     """
68:     if not isinstance(payload, dict):
69:         raise ValueError("job payload must be a JSON object")
70:     schema_version = payload.get("schema_version")
71:     if not isinstance(schema_version, int) or isinstance(schema_version, bool):
72:         raise ValueError("job payload must carry an integer schema_version")
73:     attempts = max_attempts if max_attempts is not None else WorkerConfig().retry_max_attempts
74:     row = conn.execute(
75:         _INSERT_JOB,
76:         {
77:             "job_type": job_type,
78:             "dedup_key": dedup_key,
79:             "owner_type": owner_type,
80:             "owner_id": owner_id,
81:             "input_revision": int(input_revision),
82:             "payload": json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False),
83:             "delay_seconds": float(available_at_delay_seconds),
84:             "max_attempts": int(attempts),
85:         },
86:     ).first()
87:     if row is None:
88:         existing = conn.execute(_SELECT_BY_DEDUP, {"dedup_key": dedup_key}).first()
89:         if existing is None:  # pragma: no cover - 仅理论竞态
90:             raise RuntimeError(f"dedup conflict without existing row: {dedup_key}")
91:         return str(existing[0]), True
92:     return str(row[0]), False
93: 
94: 
95: def enqueue_job(
96:     engine: Engine,
97:     *,
98:     job_type: str,
99:     dedup_key: str,
100:     owner_type: str,
101:     owner_id: str,
102:     input_revision: int,
103:     payload: dict[str, Any],
104:     available_at_delay_seconds: float = 0.0,
105:     max_attempts: Optional[int] = None,
106: ) -> tuple[str, bool]:
107:     """自开短事务入队（提交后才返回）。"""
108:     with engine.begin() as conn:
109:         return insert_job(
110:             conn,
111:             job_type=job_type,
112:             dedup_key=dedup_key,
113:             owner_type=owner_type,
114:             owner_id=owner_id,
115:             input_revision=input_revision,
116:             payload=payload,
117:             available_at_delay_seconds=available_at_delay_seconds,
118:             max_attempts=max_attempts,
119:         )
120: 
121: 
122: def enqueue_identity_enroll(
123:     engine: Engine, **kwargs: Any
124: ) -> tuple[str, bool]:
125:     """入队 identity.enroll；namespace 未决槽占用 → :class:`EnrollSlotOccupied`。
126: 
127:     索引冲突发生在本助手自开的短事务内，异常时事务已回滚，不会悬挂部分写。
128:     """
129:     try:
130:         with engine.begin() as conn:
131:             return insert_job(conn, **kwargs)
132:     except IntegrityError as exc:
133:         if _is_enroll_slot_conflict(exc):
134:             raise EnrollSlotOccupied("identity enrollment slot occupied") from exc
135:         raise

649: 随后同一事务按返回 ID 更新 running、lease_owner、lease_until、lease_revision+1、attempt_count+1；提交后调用外部服务。领取查询适用于队列，不用于普通业务“跳过被锁行”而漏读。[PostgreSQL SELECT 锁定语义](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-select.html)

651: 续租仅当 id、status=running、lease_owner、lease_revision 匹配且原租约未过期时更新。到期回收条件更新为 queued 并使旧领取代次失效。完成阶段：先锁相关业务行，再锁 T12，检查当前领取者/代次/租约和业务版本；不满足就回滚业务写，不发布结果。成功同事务提交结果、任务 succeeded、后继任务。清理失败结果图时也必须先验证未发布引用。
652: 
653: 瞬时外部错误采用有限指数退避与抖动；不可靠身份/低质量不是无限重试网络错误，而是补拍或明确失败。同步请求和队列各有尝试上限。不宣称外部调用 exactly-once：允许重复计算，不允许重复正式归档。
654: 
655: ### 9.3 人脸身份归档与新人登记
656: 
657: 三视角先质量检查并确认同人，然后做受控范围 1:N。可靠匹配用 namespace + face_subject_ref 定位 T01；歧义不归档，未命中只成为新人候选。
658: 
659: 新人注册需要 namespace 级持久协调：复用 T12 的 identity.enroll 工作项，建议部分唯一索引约束同一 namespace 只有一条 queued/running/failed 未决登记工作；其他候选分析任务等待后重搜。登记工作先持久记录 candidate_entity_id、原任务/版本、阶段和供应商 request ID，再锁外调用。网络超时先按同 EntityId 查询对账，不生成另一 ID 盲目重试。
660: 
661: 供应商索引写入已可见、与当前输入/租约仍一致后，事务建立 T01 并关联 T05；如果任务输入已被补拍替换，不能把旧登记结果归给新照片。外部成功但业务取消的人员资源保留受控对账，确认无业务引用后再清理。登记结果未确认可见时，协调项保持阻塞/待对账状态，不能释放后立即登记另一份同人候选；失败状态也必须有防止跳过未决注册的持久标记。
662: 
663: 该串行协调处理工程竞态，不证明算法能完美区分新人。供应商可见性、自动新人判定阈值、活体条件未通过 PoC，则不得开启真实自动登记。已有成员的分析不必等待新人注册队列；没有公共全库搜索入口。
664: 
665: ### 9.4 报告发布与方案交接
666: 
667: 算法临时结果图下载需白名单来源/大小限制，转存 OSS 并验证可用后才发布。锁 T05 检查照片/处理代次，固定 member_id/report_id/report_payload/report_summary/report_photo_version；插唯一 T06 waiting_inputs；插后继工作项；标分析任务成功，一次 PG 提交。
668: 
669: 测肤与计划分别可失败。报告发布后立即查询，不等待方案；方案生成输入是冻结报告与批准能力快照。大模型输出严格结构校验：方案成员/来源由服务端赋值，N 是正整数，参数和单位均在批准范围；无效结果不发布 ready。重试不更新已 ready 的方案，不重置 K/completed_at/progress_revision。
670: 
671: ### 9.5 离线和通知
672: 
673: 扫描 T03 的过期 last_seen_at 候选，逐行短事务重检，创建一次离线 episode 并维护 active_incidents。新心跳恢复关闭 episode；同一异常重复心跳不创建新 episode。设备首次从未心跳的 unknown 不直接解释为“刚离线”。
674: 
675: 绑定/目标有效且异常仍在时，以 T10 复合唯一键创建每目标通知及 T12。无目标时不记 submitted；后续新目标登记或定期扫描仍可为当前异常补建通知。异常未恢复但改绑 B 时新建 B 的通知，旧 A 通知取消，不改收件人复用旧行。
676: 
677: 投递前先在锁外向会话提供方核实会话有效性；查询失败不投递。随后短事务按 T03 → T09 → T10 → T12 重检账号、binding_revision、destination_revision、session_ref 及 episode，确认仍与刚核实的会话相同；标 sending 后在锁外发送。拿到可信受理 ID 才记 submitted，只有可信送达回执才记 delivered。发送后崩溃的 unknown 优先查供应商回执，不无条件重发。
678: 
679: 检查后到外部发送之间仍存在解绑竞争，不能用长事务锁包住推送网络调用来掩盖。消息仅写“云台状态异常，请查看”，不含成员、照片或报告；已经受理的通知不承诺撤回。
680: 
681: ## 10. 图片存储、访问与补偿
682: 
683: ### 10.1 上传流程
684: 
685: 先在 T13 建立稳定请求，再插 T11.pending（尚未创建的任务/执行外键为空）；流式写 OSS，校验格式、尺寸、大小和内容摘要，再将 T11 标 available。最终业务事务只接纳当前请求对应、purpose 正确且 available 的图片，补齐归属。图片 available 不等于对用户可访问。
686: 
687: 补拍时新版本完整视角清单由服务端构造；跨请求复用仅允许同任务已接纳图片，不接受任意 mediaId 或任意 URL。M1/M4 核验入口本版采用当前上传，不开放客户任选历史对象再当作新采集。
688: 
689: 对象 key 建议 `environment/purpose/random-media-id`，不含姓名、手机号、成员可读名称。Web/Worker 使用最小权限运行凭据；PG 不存图片二进制，日志不输出对象访问凭据。连接中断或超限时终止上传并回收临时文件。
690: 
691: ### 10.2 图片读取基础 HTTP
692: 
693: 建议补充 `GET /api/v1/media/{mediaId}/content`，属于二进制基础协议，不占用现有 M1—M5 编号。业务响应返回同源 contentUrl，不直接返回永久 OSS URL。
694: 
695: 1. 认证主体；T11 读取对象状态、用途和归属。
696: 2. 只允许业务报告投影公开的展示图片；检查 T05 冻结报告中确实引用该 mediaId。核验图、临时未归档图不可凭上传者身份直接下载。
697: 3. APP 查 T02 有效关系；云台查 T03 当前任务。通过后流式读取私有 OSS。
698: 4. 返回实际图片 MIME、no-store、X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff；不重定向至长效签名地址。本版可不支持 Range，请求不因此绕过鉴权。
699: 5. OSS 不存在返回受控错误并告警，不把缺图当报告全文不存在，也不返回内部 bucket/key。
700: 
701: 需要 3～4 次单表 SELECT 属于预期；图片访问另计，不承诺两次查询。鉴权发生在读取时，已经下载的字节无法远程收回。外部算法使用 SDK 内容或受限临时 URL；受限 URL 不提供给客户端，供应商输出 URL 不能成为任意内网抓取入口。
702: 
703: ### 10.3 生命周期
704: 
705: | 阶段 | 允许操作 | 失败补偿 |
706: |---|---|---|
707: | pending | 上传中，无业务读权限 | 超时后核对请求与 OSS，再标失败/清理 |
708: | available 未被接纳 | 等待业务最终提交 | 清理前锁请求/业务及媒体、确认无有效处理者或引用 |
709: | available 已被引用 | 业务按用途受控读 | 不按 created_at 粗暴清理；报告和人脸参考依赖必须核查 |
710: | deleting | 业务禁止新增引用，按既定保留/删除决策执行 | OSS 删除失败保留状态重试 |
711: | deleted | 对象已确认删除，保留必要审计引用 | 读取不再返回，不能恢复旧签名访问 |
712: 
713: 清理与业务接纳遵循相同锁顺序：不能先锁 T11 再等 T13/T05/T07。元数据检查需覆盖 T05.photo_versions/report_payload、T01.identity_summary、T07/T13 的有效证据引用；MVP 只自动清理明确无引用的失败上传。正式图片和人脸模板的删除由第 14 节生命周期方案驱动，不用定时 TTL 代替业务与合规判断。

1: """完成/失败写回：短事务 + 代次守卫（DD 8.1 锁顺序：先业务行后 T12）。
2: 
3: - complete_success：同一事务内 **先** 执行 handler 的业务写回调（B/C/D 扩展点，
4:   echo 为空），**后** 条件更新 async_jobs → succeeded；守卫 0 行 → StaleGeneration，
5:   整个事务回滚（业务写不得发布）。
6: - complete_failure：可重试且未超上限 → 回 queued + 指数退避 available_at +
7:   last_error；否则 failed。守卫同代次。
8: - fail_unsupported：未知 job_type / 未注册 handler / payload schema_version
9:   不符 / JSON Schema 校验失败 → 直接 failed（UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT），不重试、
10:   不循环（DD 9.1）。
11: 
12: last_error JSON（snake_case）：{"code","message","retryable","retry_after_seconds"?}。
13: """
14: from __future__ import annotations
15: 
16: import json
17: import random
18: from typing import Any, Callable, Optional
19: 
20: from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
21: 
22: from .rows import JobRow
23: 
24: 
25: class StaleGeneration(RuntimeError):
26:     """lease_owner/lease_revision/status 守卫不匹配：结果作废，事务已回滚。"""
27: 
28: 
29: BusinessTx = Callable[[Connection], None]
30: 
31: _COMPLETE_SUCCESS = text(
32:     """
33: UPDATE async_jobs
34: SET status = 'succeeded',
35:     finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
36:     last_error = NULL,
37:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
38: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
39:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
40: """
41: )
42: 
43: _REQUEUE = text(
44:     """
45: UPDATE async_jobs
46: SET status = 'queued',
47:     lease_owner = NULL,
48:     lease_until = NULL,
49:     available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :delay_seconds),
50:     last_error = CAST(:last_error AS jsonb),
51:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
52: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
53:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
54: """
55: )
56: 
57: _MARK_FAILED = text(
58:     """
59: UPDATE async_jobs
60: SET status = 'failed',
61:     finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
62:     last_error = CAST(:last_error AS jsonb),
63:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
64: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
65:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
66: """
67: )
68: 
69: # 合法等待态重排（defer）：同 job、同 dedup_key/input_revision；退还本次 claim
70: # 的 attempt 增量（GREATEST 防负），lease_revision+1 作废旧领取代次，available_at
71: # 推到下次检查时刻。**绝不写/读 last_error**（诊断字段不得驱动决策）。
72: _DEFER = text(
73:     """
74: UPDATE async_jobs
75: SET status = 'queued',
76:     lease_owner = NULL,
77:     lease_until = NULL,
78:     available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => :defer_seconds),
79:     attempt_count = GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0),
80:     lease_revision = lease_revision + 1,
81:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
82: WHERE id = :id AND status = 'running'
83:   AND lease_owner = :worker_id AND lease_revision = :lease_revision
84:   AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
85: """
86: )
87: 
88: 
89: def backoff_seconds(
90:     attempt_count: int,
91:     *,
92:     base_seconds: int,
93:     cap_seconds: int,
94:     rng: Optional[random.Random] = None,
95: ) -> int:
96:     """指数退避 + 抖动：delay = min(base * 2^(attempt-1), cap) + U(0, 0.2*delay)。
97: 
98:     attempt_count 为本次已消耗的尝试数（claim 时递增，最小 1）。
99:     dev 初值 5s→300s（decisions #13）。
100:     """
101:     r = rng or random
102:     exp = min(float(base_seconds) * (2 ** max(int(attempt_count) - 1, 0)), float(cap_seconds))
103:     return int(round(exp + r.uniform(0.0, 0.2 * exp)))
104: 
105: 
106: def make_last_error(
107:     code: str, message: str, *, retryable: bool, retry_after_seconds: Optional[int] = None
108: ) -> str:
109:     err: dict[str, Any] = {
110:         "code": code,
111:         "message": message[:2000],
112:         "retryable": retryable,
113:     }
114:     if retry_after_seconds is not None:
115:         err["retry_after_seconds"] = int(retry_after_seconds)
116:     return json.dumps(err, ensure_ascii=False)
117: 
118: 
119: def complete_success(
120:     engine: Engine,
121:     claim: JobRow,
122:     *,
123:     handler_result_tx: Optional[BusinessTx] = None,
124: ) -> None:
125:     """成功路径单事务：业务写 → T12 succeeded（守卫不满足则全部回滚）。"""
126:     with engine.begin() as conn:
127:         if handler_result_tx is not None:
128:             # 扩展点：B/C/D 在此写业务表（字段级、先锁业务行）；echo 无业务写
129:             handler_result_tx(conn)
130:         res = conn.execute(
131:             _COMPLETE_SUCCESS,
132:             {
133:                 "id": claim.id,
134:                 "worker_id": claim.lease_owner,
135:                 "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision,
136:             },
137:         )
138:         if res.rowcount == 0:
139:             # 代次失效：连同业务写一起回滚，结果不得发布
140:             raise StaleGeneration(
141:                 f"job {claim.id} stale generation on complete (revision={claim.lease_revision})"
142:             )
143: 
144: 
145: def complete_deferred(
146:     engine: Engine,
147:     claim: JobRow,
148:     *,
149:     defer_seconds: float,
150:     business_tx: Optional[BusinessTx] = None,
151: ) -> None:
152:     """合法等待态重排（defer）单事务：业务守卫 → 代次围栏回 queued。
153: 
154:     **仅用于合法等待态**（如能力待补齐）：同一 job、同一 ``dedup_key``/
155:     ``input_revision``，不产生后继任务；退还**本次 claim** 的 attempt 增量
156:     （``attempt_count = GREATEST(attempt_count - 1, 0)``，永不为负），
157:     ``lease_revision + 1`` 让旧领取代次失效，``available_at`` 推到
158:     ``now + defer_seconds``。绝不触碰业务 generation revision。
159: 
160:     真实算法/网络失败**必须**走 :func:`complete_failure` 并消耗 attempt 预算，
161:     不得用本函数掩盖失败。
162: 
163:     ``business_tx`` 若给定，先在**同一连接/事务**执行（先锁业务行，DD 8.1）：
164:     调用方用它复核业务输入仍是本任务输入版本（不一致抛
165:     :class:`StaleGeneration`），并可写入合法等待态；抛出即整体回滚。
166: 
167:     守卫 0 行（陈旧租约 / 重复 defer / 租约已过期）→ :class:`StaleGeneration`，
168:     事务已回滚：无 refund、无状态变更、无双重退款。本函数**不写也不读**
169:     ``last_error``（诊断字段不得驱动决策）。
170:     """
171:     with engine.begin() as conn:
172:         if business_tx is not None:
173:             business_tx(conn)
174:         res = conn.execute(
175:             _DEFER,
176:             {
177:                 "id": claim.id,
178:                 "worker_id": claim.lease_owner,
179:                 "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision,
180:                 "defer_seconds": float(defer_seconds),
181:             },
182:         )
183:         if res.rowcount == 0:
184:             raise StaleGeneration(
185:                 f"job {claim.id} stale generation on defer (revision={claim.lease_revision})"
186:             )
187: 
188: 
189: def complete_failure(
190:     engine: Engine,
191:     claim: JobRow,
192:     *,
193:     code: str,
194:     message: str,
195:     retryable: bool,
196:     backoff_base_seconds: int = 5,
197:     backoff_cap_seconds: int = 300,
198: ) -> None:
199:     """失败路径：可重试且未超 attempt 上限 → 退避回 queued；否则 failed。
200: 
201:     0 行守卫 → StaleGeneration（调用方记日志丢弃即可：回收器会重新入队）。
202:     """
203:     will_retry = retryable and claim.attempt_count < claim.max_attempts
204:     if will_retry:
205:         delay = backoff_seconds(
206:             claim.attempt_count,
207:             base_seconds=backoff_base_seconds,
208:             cap_seconds=backoff_cap_seconds,
209:         )
210:         last_error = make_last_error(
211:             code, message, retryable=True, retry_after_seconds=delay
212:         )
213:         stmt = _REQUEUE
214:         params: dict[str, Any] = {"delay_seconds": delay}
215:     else:
216:         last_error = make_last_error(code, message, retryable=False)
217:         stmt = _MARK_FAILED
218:         params = {}
219:     params.update(
220:         {
221:             "id": claim.id,
222:             "worker_id": claim.lease_owner,
223:             "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision,
224:             "last_error": last_error,
225:         }
226:     )
227:     with engine.begin() as conn:
228:         res = conn.execute(stmt, params)
229:         if res.rowcount == 0:
230:             raise StaleGeneration(
231:                 f"job {claim.id} stale generation on failure write (revision={claim.lease_revision})"
232:             )
233: 
234: 
235: def fail_unsupported(
236:     engine: Engine,
237:     claim: JobRow,
238:     *,
239:     reason_code: str = "UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT",
240:     message: str = "unsupported contract: no registered handler or payload schema mismatch",
241: ) -> None:
242:     """契约不认识 → 立即 failed（retryable=false），绝不进入重试循环。"""
243:     last_error = make_last_error(reason_code, message, retryable=False)
244:     with engine.begin() as conn:
245:         res = conn.execute(
246:             _MARK_FAILED,
247:             {
248:                 "id": claim.id,
249:                 "worker_id": claim.lease_owner,
250:                 "lease_revision": claim.lease_revision,
251:                 "last_error": last_error,
252:             },
253:         )
254:         if res.rowcount == 0:
255:             raise StaleGeneration(
256:                 f"job {claim.id} stale generation on unsupported (revision={claim.lease_revision})"
257:             )

1: """运行循环：recover → claim → 线程池分发（每任务一个续租看门狗）→ 代次受控完成。
2: 
3: - 至少一次执行：handler 可能在崩溃/回收后重复运行；正式落地由完成事务的
4:   代次守卫 + 业务输入版本复核阻断（不宣称 exactly-once）。
5: - 优雅停机（SIGTERM/SIGINT）：停止领取新任务；等待在途 handler 完成其
6:   （短）完成事务；未及完成的由租约过期回收接管（ARCH 11.2）。
7: - 未知 job_type / 未注册 handler / payload 契约不符 → fail_unsupported，
8:   直接 failed 不循环（B/C/D 业务类型在 A 包即走此扩展点路径）。
9: """
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: import logging
13: import threading
14: from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
15: from typing import Optional
16: 
17: from sqlalchemy import Engine
18: 
19: from ..config import WorkerConfig
20: from ..db import create_db_engine
21: from ..handlers import (
22:     HandlerContext,
23:     JobFailed,
24:     UnsupportedPayload,
25:     get_handler,
26: )
27: from ..logging_setup import mlog
28: from .claim import claim_batch
29: from .complete import (
30:     StaleGeneration,
31:     complete_deferred,
32:     complete_failure,
33:     complete_success,
34:     fail_unsupported,
35: )
36: from .expire import recover_expired, release_claim
37: from .renew import LeaseRenewer
38: from .rows import JobRow
39: 
40: log = logging.getLogger("mvp_worker.loop")
41: 
42: 
43: class WorkerRuntime:
44:     def __init__(self, config: WorkerConfig, engine: Optional[Engine] = None) -> None:
45:         self.cfg = config
46:         self.engine = engine or create_db_engine(
47:             config.runtime_dsn,
48:             pool_size=config.pool_size,
49:             max_overflow=config.max_overflow,
50:         )
51:         self.stop_event = threading.Event()
52: 
53:     def dispose(self) -> None:
54:         self.engine.dispose()
55: 
56:     # ---------------- dispatch ----------------
57: 
58:     def process_job(self, claim: JobRow) -> None:
59:         """处理一个已领取（running，新代次）任务。所有 DB 写都是字段级条件更新。"""
60:         worker_id = self.cfg.worker_id
61:         fields = claim.log_fields()
62:         mlog(log, logging.INFO, "job.claimed", workerId=worker_id, **fields)
63: 
64:         handler = get_handler(claim.job_type)
65:         if handler is None:
66:             # A 包扩展点：B/C/D 注册业务 handler 前，此类任务在此隔离（不重试循环）
67:             mlog(
68:                 log,
69:                 logging.WARNING,
70:                 "job.unsupported_type",
71:                 workerId=worker_id,
72:                 **fields,
73:                 note="no registered handler: extension point for B/C/D",
74:             )
75:             self._write_unsupported(claim, message=(
76:                 f"no registered handler for job_type={claim.job_type} "
77:                 "(extension point for B/C/D)"
78:             ))
79:             return
80: 
81:         try:
82:             handler.validate(claim.payload)
83:         except UnsupportedPayload as exc:
84:             mlog(log, logging.WARNING, "job.payload_unsupported",
85:                  workerId=worker_id, **fields, reason=str(exc)[:300])
86:             self._write_unsupported(claim, message=str(exc)[:500])
87:             return
88: 
89:         abort_event = threading.Event()
90:         ctx = HandlerContext(
91:             engine=self.engine, config=self.cfg, job=claim, abort_event=abort_event
92:         )
93:         renewer = LeaseRenewer(
94:             self.engine,
95:             claim,
96:             lease_seconds=self.cfg.lease_seconds,
97:             renew_interval_seconds=self.cfg.renew_interval_seconds,
98:             abort_event=abort_event,
99:         ).start()
100:         try:
101:             result = handler.handle(ctx, claim)
102:         except JobFailed as exc:
103:             self._finish_failure(claim, exc.code, exc.message, exc.retryable)
104:             return
105:         except Exception as exc:  # 未预期异常 → 按临时错误退避重试
106:             mlog(log, logging.ERROR, "job.handler_exception",
107:                  workerId=worker_id, **fields, errorClass=type(exc).__name__)
108:             self._finish_failure(
109:                 claim, "HANDLER_ERROR", f"unhandled {type(exc).__name__}", retryable=True
110:             )

1: """租约围栏的业务写事务：standalone 业务写必须先证明仍持有当前租约代次。
2: 
3: 背景（oracle B1）：handler 内有些业务写在 ``complete_*`` 事务之外自开短事务
4: （状态标记、阶段持久化、终态标记）。这些写若只按 ``processing_revision``/
5: ``status`` 守卫，那么**租约已过期被回收、新 owner 接管后**，旧 worker 仍可能提交
6: 终态业务数据（如 T05 failed），污染新 owner 的任务；只有随后的 ``complete_failure``
7: 被围栏丢弃，业务写却已落库。
8: 
9: 本助手在**同一事务**内先 ``SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`` 锁住该 job 的 ``async_jobs``
10: 行并复核 ``status='running'``、``lease_owner``、``lease_revision`` 与
11: ``lease_until`` 仍活跃；任一不符抛 :class:`StaleGeneration`（事务整体回滚，无业务
12: 写、无 spurious 终态）。锁定 ``async_jobs`` 行后，业务写与 job 状态变更在该行锁上
13: 串行：若新 owner 先提交 ``complete_*``，旧 worker 的围栏读到非 running/较新代次而
14: 失败；反之旧 worker 先持锁时新 owner 会阻塞至其回滚/提交后再判。
15: 
16: handler 选择（已在各 D handler 的 ``handle`` 包装中实现）：捕获
17: ``StaleGeneration`` 后**返回 None**，而非向上抛。原因见 ``runtime/loop.py``：
18: 向上抛会落入通用 ``except Exception`` → 记 ERROR ``job.handler_exception`` 后再走
19: ``complete_failure``（同样被围栏丢弃），产生两条日志且第一条误报为未处理异常；
20: 返回 None 则走 ``complete_success``→围栏丢弃，只留一条 ``job.complete_stale_generation``
21: WARN，语义最干净（单日志、不误报）。
22: """
23: from __future__ import annotations
24: 
25: from contextlib import contextmanager
26: from typing import Iterator
27: 
28: from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
29: 
30: from ...runtime.complete import StaleGeneration
31: from ...runtime.rows import JobRow
32: 
33: _FENCE = text(
34:     """
35: SELECT status, lease_owner, lease_revision,
36:        (lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS lease_live
37: FROM async_jobs
38: WHERE id = :job_id
39: FOR UPDATE
40: """
41: )
42: 
43: 
44: @contextmanager
45: def fenced_business_tx(engine: Engine, job: JobRow) -> Iterator[Connection]:
46:     """在仍持有 ``job`` 当前租约代次的前提下，提供一个可做业务写的事务连接。
47: 
48:     退出时（正常）提交；任一围栏不符抛 :class:`StaleGeneration` 并回滚。
49:     """
50:     with engine.begin() as conn:
51:         row = conn.execute(_FENCE, {"job_id": job.id}).mappings().first()

56:             or int(row["lease_revision"]) != int(job.lease_revision)
57:             or not row["lease_live"]

61:                 f" (owner={job.lease_owner}, revision={job.lease_revision})"

1: """结果图归档：算法输出图 → 受控 T11 ``assessment_result`` 行 + 存储对象。
2: 
3: 流程（DD 9.4 / 10.1）：先按 ``assessment_id + photo_version + purpose`` 单表读取
4: 既有结果图，用 ``storage_metadata->>'provider_ref'`` 匹配复用（至少一次重跑不产生
5: 孤儿重复）；否则插 pending 行 → 存储 put（事务外）→ 置 available（内容类型/大小/
6: 摘要）。任何归档失败都**不发布报告**，由 handler 决定可重试或终止。
7: """
8: from __future__ import annotations
9: 
10: import hashlib
11: import json
12: import uuid
13: from typing import Any, Optional
14: 
15: from sqlalchemy import Connection, Engine, text
16: 
17: from ...media.storage import build_object_key
18: from .constants import ALLOWED_RESULT_CONTENT_TYPES, DEFAULT_BUCKET
19: 
20: _SELECT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
21:     """
22: SELECT id, object_key, state, content_type, byte_size, storage_metadata
23: FROM media_objects
24: WHERE assessment_id = CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid)
25:   AND photo_version = :photo_version
26:   AND purpose = 'assessment_result'
27: """
28: )
29: 
30: # B3：同 (task, photo_version) 的结果图归档串行化（事务级 advisory lock）。
31: # V1/V2 无结果图唯一约束且迁移禁改，故用 advisory lock 保证并发归档同一
32: # (task,version,provider_ref) 至多一行 T11、至多一个存储对象。
33: _ADVISORY_LOCK = text(
34:     """
35: SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(
36:     hashtextextended(
37:         'd:result-archive:' || :assessment_id || ':' || CAST(:photo_version AS text), 0
38:     )
39: )
40: """
41: )
42: 
43: _INSERT_RESULT_MEDIA = text(
44:     """
45: INSERT INTO media_objects (id, bucket, object_key, purpose, assessment_id, photo_version,
46:                            member_id, uploader_type, state, storage_metadata,
47:                            created_at, updated_at)
48: VALUES (CAST(:id AS uuid), :bucket, :object_key, 'assessment_result',
49:         CAST(:assessment_id AS uuid), :photo_version, NULL, 'worker', 'pending',
50:         CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
51: """
52: )
53: 
54: _UPDATE_MEDIA_AVAILABLE = text(
55:     """
56: UPDATE media_objects
57: SET state = 'available', content_type = :content_type, byte_size = :byte_size,
58:     content_hash = :content_hash, storage_metadata = CAST(:storage_metadata AS jsonb),
59:     updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
60: WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid) AND state IN ('pending', 'available')
61: """
62: )
63: 
64: 
65: _SELECT_SOURCE_MEDIA = text(
66:     "SELECT id, object_key, state FROM media_objects WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)"
67: )

70: class ArchiveError(RuntimeError):
71:     """结果图归档失败；``terminal`` 表示重试无法恢复。"""
72: 
73:     def __init__(self, code: str, message: str, *, terminal: bool) -> None:
74:         super().__init__(f"{code}: {message}")
75:         self.code = code
76:         self.message = message
77:         self.terminal = terminal
